tested.title: OpenStack Powered
tested.description: This product is OpenStack Powered. It contains OpenStack software and has been approved by the OpenInfra Foundation. [Learn more about becoming an OpenStack Powered product here](/brand/openstack-powered/).

bareMetal.title: Uses Ironic bare metal
bareMetal.description: This product uses [OpenStack's Ironic Bare Metal](/bare-metal/) service. Ironic allows users to manage bare metal infrastructure like they would virtual machines and provides ideal infrastructure to run container orchestration frameworks like Kubernetes to optimize performance.

federatedIdentity.title: Supports federated identity
federatedIdentity.description: This product supports OpenStack Federated Identity, allowing it to connect to other OpenStack clouds for Authentication and Authorization.
